pages.text: Put a hook in the hook slot and press H to fire it at a block and it pulls you there. Better hooks reach further and pull faster.
pages.title: Grappling Hooks
Amethyst Hook
pages.text: Three seconds of Slow Falling when it lets go.

pages.title: Diamond Hook
pages.text: Longer reach and a faster pull than amethyst.

pages.title: Netherite Hook
pages.text: The longest reach and fastest pull.

pages.title: Stillwind Hook
pages.text: Hangs you dead still between its two hooks. Found only in trial chamber vaults.
